commands.name: property.set
commands.description: Write typed public property; optionally source and sourcePath instead of value
commands.requirements: Existing writable member; vector channel preserves other channels; script leaf fields only

commands.name: property.sync
commands.description: Continuously copy source property to target property
commands.requirements: Both properties compatible; stable object IDs; self or source by unique name/ID

commands.name: variable.set
commands.requirements: type bool/int/uint/int64/uint64/float/double/string/vector2/vector3/vector4/color/object; preserves existing type if omitted; object is UUID string

commands.name: variable.copy
commands.requirements: Existing source; type optional, preserve destination type

commands.name: variable.calculate
commands.description: Compute from two variables or variable and literal value
commands.requirements: operator add/subtract/multiply/divide; vectors elementwise or scalar; string add only; divide zero rejected

commands.name: tilemap.set
commands.requirements: TilemapRenderer valid grid coordinate and tile type; -1 clears cell

commands.name: tilemap.solid
commands.description: Configure tile type as collision solid
commands.requirements: Existing tile type and collision generation configured
